subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Occupational Fraud Statistics
description: A micro-lesson that makes Occupational Fraud Statistics usable.

hook.text: Companies lose an estimated 5% of annual revenue to fraud. Most of it is never detected.

buildup.text: The ACFE's annual report tracks thousands of fraud cases across industries and countries.

discovery.text: The median loss per fraud case is $117,000. Cases take 12 months to detect on average.

twist.text: Tips from employees catch more fraud than audits, controls, or law enforcement combined.

climax.text: Fraud is a predictable cost of business. The question isn't whether it's happening — it's how much.

punchline.text: 5% of revenue. 12 months to detect. Tips catch the most.

quiz.question: What catches the most occupational fraud?
